test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Rekha has two laptops of the same kind. She sold one of them at ₹32,000 and incurred a loss of 20%. At what price (in ₹) should she sell the second laptop to gain a profit of 20%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (S.P.) of 1st laptop = Rs.32000

Loss% = 20%

**Concept used:**

Cost price (C.P) = (S.P × 100)/(100 - L%)

**Calculation:**

C.P. of 1st laptop = (32000 × 100)/(100 - 20)

⇒ (32000 × 100)/80 = Rs.40000

S.P of 2nd laptop = 40000 × 120% = Rs.48000 

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.48000.**
